lens: geometry/proportion first, then materials/colour, lighting on seats, artefacts

details.detail: Fabric colour: now on target. q15 mosaic back #303d68 (R/B 0.46, G/B 0.59) vs y_47300 dotted seat #2e3c67 (0.45/0.59). Diamond seat in q15 #3d4c7d vs y_47302 #3e4a7a. The r3 chroma complaint is fixed.

Diamond variant (yFabricB): crisp now, not blobs, and at the right scale (about 0.065-0.075 m tall). But it is a perfectly regular, high-contrast checkerboard of pale diamonds on a vertical knit-tick ground. The photos show a low-contrast ikat/argyle: stepped, ragged diamond edges, some diamonds chained into zig-zag bands, and a mottled ground. The contrast is too strong: model p10/p90 luminance 51/142 (e4) and 53/132 (q15), photo 54/120 (y_47302). It is the most eye-catching seat in q15 and q16.
Tick and mosaic variants: the horizontal-dash mosaic matches the y_47306 right seat, and the vertical tick matches the y_47300 left seat. Acceptable.

Headrest geometry: this is the largest shape error. In the photos the headrest is a separate proud cushion about 0.19 m tall with bulbous rounded wing ends and a shadow line under it. The fabric back rises about 0.055 m ABOVE the cushion (y_47306 right seat: back top y130, cushion 185-370 px at 965 px/m). In the model the back loft stops at BH y 0.62 and the headrest loft (0.62-0.83) IS the top of the seat. Nothing rises above it, the wings don't bulge and there is no gap under it (q15, q16, e1).

Headrest cover: the size (0.27 wide, about 0.65 of the back width) matches y_47306 (268/415 px). But it is a rigid flat board in one plane, with a 0.04 m fold that reads as a thick lighter-edged slab (q16 foreground). Its lower edge floats about 0.02-0.04 m in front of the cushion and back (side view e3). The leather grain is coarse pebble (worley 4 mm cells at normal 0.32), visible as orange peel in the q15 foreground; the photo cover is a smooth matte leatherette.

Rear shell / screen hood: the proportions now match sans15. Hood about 0.37 wide x 0.335 tall in the model, against 0.364 x 0.336 measured at 981 px/m from the 0.316 m glass. The glass, the bezel margins and the handset position are all right, and the hood depth reads in e2 and q17. Two faults: the blue fabric band below the shell, and the lower furniture (see issues).
IFE screen, bezel and handset: the black glass border (#0b0a0e vs photo #1f1a27, slightly too black) and the handset with its D-pad and colour keys match y_47305 and sans15.

Lower seat-back furniture: the tray, placard, mesh pockets and centre leatherette pocket are present. The coat-hook disc sits on the hood face beside the handset. In sans15 the round recess is on the ledge band BELOW the hood at tray-top level, mirroring the pictogram placard, and nothing sits beside the handset. The AC/USB plate is half-buried under the tray corner and renders as a black L-shaped sliver (e6). The magazine is a saturated blue stripe floating on the shell above the pocket, not tucked into it.

Armrests: the length and the white paddle are right. The front end reads as a toy 'ball on a stick': a separate 0.05 m white cube-ball sits on a white post, with a knuckle disc on the post. In y_47302 the front support is a continuous light-grey sculpted bracket about 0.06 wide from the arm down to the spreader. The pivot knuckle (grey ring with dark centre, about 0.04 m) sits at pan-top level, and the white paddle leaf hangs from it.

Pillows: too dark and too saturated. q16 pillow #151b3e (R/B 0.34, G/B 0.44) vs y_47300 #30395f (0.51/0.60). The shape is a bevelled box with a flat inner plateau outline, where the photo shows a puffy pinched-corner cushion. It is also small: 0.27 x 0.21 against about 0.33 x 0.24 in y_47300 (0.85-0.88 of the back width, allowing for perspective).

Under-seat structure: legs, spreaders, the baggage bar and the IFE box are plausible. The life-vest pouch is a tiny 0.12 x 0.05 block hidden under the pan, and only the red tab shows (e8, e1). y_47302 shows a prominent dark saucer pouch about 0.18-0.2 m across with a long red strap.

Footrest: ribbed pedals and end caps are now present. The hanger tops end about 0.03 m aft of the rear spreader tube with no attachment, so they float (e8). The two hanger links meet with a visible offset or kink.
Belts: blue webbing and a grey buckle cover, as in y_47303.

Lighting on the seats: the rear shells render mid-grey in the seated view (q18 #868a90 vs y_47305 #bac1cf, about 30 % dark). They read acceptably in q17. There is a thin bright diagonal light streak across a fabric back at the right edge of q15 (x 870-930, y 330-385), probably a window sun shaft; it looks like a scratch.

issues.detail: The headrest is not a separate proud cushion, and the back does not rise above it.
issues.problem: In econSeat the back loft ends at SEC(0.62, 0.38, ...). The yHead loft covers BH y 0.62-0.83 with width 0.37 and depth 0.09, so the headrest forms the top of the seat. It has no bulbous wings, no shadow gap below it and no fabric above it.
issues.evidence: y_47306 right seat (965 px/m from the 0.43 m back): the back top is at y130, the cushion runs 185-370 (0.19 m tall), so the back rises about 0.055 m above the cushion. The wing ends are round bolsters about 0.06 m proud. y_47301 foreground and sans13 show the same. The model (cmp_head.png, cmp_front.png, e1) has a flat top.
issues.fix: In econSeat, extend the back loft upward: after SEC(0.58,...) use SEC(0.70, 0.40, 0.07, 0.004, 0.028), SEC(0.82, 0.39, 0.06, 0.006, 0.025), SEC(0.86, 0.35, 0.04, 0.006, 0.018). Keep the RS hood top at 0.775-0.80 so the white shell still wraps behind. Move the headrest down and forward: SEC(0.58, 0.33, 0.06, -0.045, 0.028), SEC(0.60, 0.37, 0.09, -0.06, 0.045), SEC(0.75, 0.375, 0.095, -0.062, 0.047), SEC(0.77, 0.35, 0.07, -0.055, 0.035), SEC(0.78, 0.30, 0.04, -0.045, 0.02). That gives a 0.19 m cushion proud of the back face by about 0.05, with its top about 0.08 below the new seat top. Use a larger corner r (0.045) so the wing ends round off. In econUnitFar, add a 0.43 x 0.06 back cap at y 0.83 in the same way.

issues.detail: The headrest cover is a rigid floating slab.
issues.problem: The cover is gRBox(0.27, 0.22, 0.008) at BH (0, 0.725, -0.082) plus a 0.04-deep top fold box. It is planar, while the cushion front is curved. At the lower edge (y 0.615) the cushion front is only at z -0.055 and the back at -0.038, so the cover hangs 0.02-0.04 m in air (e3 side view). From above, the fold box reads as a thick board (q16 foreground).
issues.evidence: raterB/e3z.png: dark plate standing off the cushion. raterB/cmp_head.png: the model cover looks like a TV panel; the y_47301 cover is thin and drapes over the cushion, with a soft sag at the lower edge.
issues.fix: After moving the headrest (previous issue), build the cover as a thin loft that follows the cushion front: sections at y 0.785 (top fold, z = cushion front - 0.004), 0.75, 0.66 and 0.60 (z = cushion front - 0.004 at each), then a 0.045 m hanging lip from 0.60 to 0.555, angled 8 deg back toward the back face (ending about 0.006 m off it). Width 0.27, thickness 0.004. Replace the 0.04-deep fold box with a 0.025 m rounded wrap (gRBox(0.27, 0.006, 0.025, 0.003)) sitting on the cushion top. Give yCover its own smoother grain: l: LAYER.vinyl, or leather with the LAYER_PARAMS[2] normal at 0.12. Current leather is 9 tiles/m x 28 worley cells at normal 0.32, which shows as orange peel in q15_fg.png.

issues.detail: Blue fabric band shows below the rear shell on every seat back.
issues.problem: The rear shell RS starts at BH y -0.03, but the seat-pan cushion (cushionSecs at z -0.28, depth 0.47) extends to about z -0.045, behind and below the shell bottom. A 3-4 cm band of cushion fabric shows beneath every shell from the rear.
issues.evidence: e6z.png, e2_back and e8big.png show a blue diamond/tick band under the white shell. q17 shows it on the near rows. In y_47303 (left seats) and sans15 the grey shell lip and pockets reach down to the pan underside with no fabric showing.
issues.fix: Prepend RS rows [-0.12, 0.066, 0.03, 0.44, 0.018] and [-0.06, 0.07, 0.03, 0.446, 0.018] so the shell skirt reaches world y ~0.36, below the pan top. Or shorten the pan so its rear stays inside the back: change the pan transform z from -0.28 to -0.30 and depth 0.47 to 0.45.

issues.detail: The diamond fabric is too regular and too contrasty.
issues.problem: LAYER.yDiamond (photo layer 24) now tiles a perfectly even pale-diamond checkerboard over a vertical knit tick at albedo strength 1.4 (LAYER_PARAMS[24]).
issues.evidence: cmp_diamond.png. Photos y_47302 and y_47306: ragged, stepped ikat diamonds, some chained into zig-zag bands, over a mottled ground, low contrast (p10/p90 54/120). Model e4 51/142 and q15 53/132. It is the most eye-catching element in q15 and q16.
issues.fix: In 03_tex.js (shared file, one-line edit) lower LAYER_PARAMS[24] albedo from 1.4 to 1.0. In make_swatches.py, when building y_diamond: quantise the diamond mask edges to 3-4 mm steps (nearest-neighbour downsample by 6, then upsample). Drop or randomise about 20 % of the diamonds per tile, and blend the ground from y_mosaic speckle instead of the vertical tick. Target render p10/p90 of about 55/120.

issues.detail: The armrest front reads as a ball on a stick.
issues.problem: In econUnit: gRBox(0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.022, 2) at (xa, 0.645, -0.40), a white 0.042-wide post and a knuckle cylinder, all separate pieces in the arm colour.
issues.evidence: cmp_arm.png: y_47302 shows a continuous grey sculpted bracket about 0.06 wide from the arm nose down to the spreader. The pivot is a grey ring with a dark centre about 0.04 m across at pan-top level (~0.46), with the white paddle leaf hanging from it. The model shows a white knob on a white stick.
issues.fix: Delete the cube-ball. End the arm loft with a rounded nose: add SEC(0.685, 0.04, 0.30, -0.235, 0.018) and extend the front to z -0.41 with a 0.03 m bevel. Replace the post with a loft of 3 sections, width 0.058 and depth 0.05, from (y 0.64, z -0.40) to (y 0.46, z -0.39) to (y 0.30, z -0.37), in a new SEATMAT.armPost {c: '#a9aeb4', r: 0.45, l: LAYER.plastic}. Move the knuckle to y 0.46: gCyl(0.02, 0.02, 0.064) in #9ea3a9 with a gCyl(0.009) dark #3a3e45 centre cap. Hang the paddle from 0.46 (centre y 0.28).

issues.detail: The pillow is too dark, too saturated, too small and too geometric.
issues.problem: SEATMAT.yPillow #2e3860 with LAYER.fabric renders #151b3e (R/B 0.34). The cushionSecs(0.27, 0.21, 0.08, ..., edge 0.035) loft gives a flat plateau with a bevelled rim.
issues.evidence: q16_pil.png #151b3e vs y_47300 pillow #30395f (R/B 0.51, G/B 0.60). y_47300 pillows are about 0.85 of the back width, puffy, with pinched corners.
issues.fix: yPillow c '#48527c' (same tone-curve lift the yFabric fix used). Change the pillow to cushionSecs(0.33, 0.24, 0.10, -0.05, {edge: 0.05, r: 0.06, crown: 0.03}) so it domes, and pinch the corners by shrinking the end sections' width 8 %. Reposition at BH y 0.13, z -0.15 so it still rests at the crease.

issues.detail: The AC/USB plate is buried in the tray corner and renders as a black L-shaped sliver.
issues.problem: The plate at on(0.205, 0.011, 0.185) (0.06 x 0.07) overlaps the tray (on(0.30), 0.40 x 0.20, spanning y 0.20-0.40 and dx ±0.20). The tray's front face (0.018) is proud of the plate (0.014).
issues.evidence: e6z.png: a black L at the right-hand tray corner on every seat.
issues.fix: Move the plate below the tray, between the tray bottom and the right mesh pocket: on(0.175, 0.006, 0.175), size 0.05 x 0.035, black insert 0.036 x 0.022. Or follow y_47307 and put it on the seat-back side face under the arm.

issues.detail: The coat hook is in the wrong place, and the magazine floats above its pocket.
issues.problem: The coat-hook discs sit at hz(HY, 0, 0.14), on the hood face beside the handset. The magazine is gQuad(0.18, 0.03) at on(0.19, 0.02), above the pocket top (0.18), in saturated #2c5fb0.
issues.evidence: sans15: the round recess sits on the ledge band below the hood (tray-top level, right), mirroring the pictogram placard on the left, with nothing beside the handset. The q18 grey disc beside the handset is not in any photo. e6z: the magazine reads as a blue stripe decal.
issues.fix: Move both discs to on(0.37, 0.019, 0.13), mirroring the placard at -0.13. Magazine: on(0.17, 0.014), gQuad(0.17, 0.05), c '#3b5b98', so the pocket flap (front 0.026) covers its lower part and only about 1.5 cm shows above the pocket top.

issues.detail: The life-vest pouch is almost invisible, and the footrest hangers float.
issues.problem: The pouch is gRBox(0.12, 0.05, 0.03) at y 0.24, z -0.30, hidden under the pan. The footrest hangers start at z -0.0675 with top y ~0.31, about 0.03 m aft of the rear spreader tube (z -0.10), and have no mount.
issues.evidence: y_47302: dark saucer pouch about 0.18-0.2 m across, clearly visible under each seat front, with a long red strap. e8big.png: only red tabs are visible, and the white hangers stand free with a kink between the links.
issues.fix: Pouch: gCyl(0.09, 0.08, 0.035, 16) in #2b2e33 at (x0, 0.20, -0.36), tilted -12 deg about x. Strap gBox(0.02, 0.10, 0.004) in #c8252b hanging from its front rim. Hangers: add a clamp gRBox(0.035, 0.03, 0.04) in SEATMAT.frame at (x0 ± 0.13, 0.30, -0.10) on the tube. Start the upper link at z -0.095 and overlap the two links by 0.01 at the joint, with a small gCyl(0.012) pin cap.

issues.detail: The rear shells are under-lit in the seated view, and a bright streak crosses a seat in q15.
issues.problem: Lighting/AO: the shell faces render about 30 % dark from a seat, and a thin diagonal sun or glint streak crosses a fabric back.
issues.evidence: q18 shell #868a90 vs y_47305 #bac1cf. q15_art.png diagonal streak at x 870-930, y 330-385.
issues.fix: For the lighting owner (12_scene.js / 04_shaders.js): cap the AO volume's darkening on seat-back rear faces (clamp ao >= 0.75 for the econ shell material), or add 15 % fill from the PSU downlights. Clamp window sun-shaft projections to the floor and sidewall, or soften their edge (smoothstep width about 0.05 m) so they don't draw hairlines across seat backs.

questionsForUser: Seat-back height: I have no sourced number for the Recaro CL3710 back height above the floor. The model headrest top is about 1.28 m (BH 0.83 at 13 deg). Raising the back cap by 0.055 m (issue 1) would bring it to about 1.33 m unless the headrest is moved down, as proposed. Do you have a Recaro or ANA spec for the overall seat height?

Should the diamond (ikat) fabric stay as a photo swatch? The best available frontal crops (y_47302 middle, y_47306 left) are small and oblique, so a procedural stepped-diamond layer may be more faithful.
Is the AC/USB outlet on this aircraft on the seat-back face (under the tray) or on the seat front between the legs, as y_47307 / y_47302 seem to show? The model currently puts it on the seat back.
